name: ISG15 conjugation in interferon-stimulated antiviral defense
rationale: All three members concern ISGylation by the interferon-stimulated gene ISG15, an effector arm absent from confusables, which cover IFN induction, RIG-I/MDA5 sensing and IFN signatures.

name: Immunoregulatory IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling and IL-10/IL-12 production control, the suppressive cytokine axis, unlike confusables centred on IL-12/IL-23/IL-17 and fungal lectin signaling.

name: Sodium import regulation in aldosterone and renin-angiotensin control
rationale: Members regulate cellular sodium (and coupled proton) transport in aldosterone and renal renin-angiotensin contexts, whereas confusables emphasise calcium/potassium transport or angiotensin-driven blood pressure and volume.

name: Bile acid metabolism and intestinal sterol absorption
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis, recycling, transport, signaling and transporter defects plus intestinal cholesterol/lipid absorption (ABCG5/8), distinguishing from xenobiotic-transport, lipoprotein and peroxisomal confusables.

qualifier: fibroblast fate, matrix turnover, TGF-beta1 production
name: Fibroblast-driven fibrotic repair with matrix turnover and TGF-beta1 production
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation and survival, connective-tissue replacement and ECM assembly/breakdown; elastin catabolism, MMP secretion and TGF-beta1 production set it apart from migration-, collagen- and SMAD-focused confusables.

qualifier: 5' cap formation, decapping and snRNP biogenesis
name: Cap-centred mRNA processing, decapping decay and snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members span mRNA capping, cap hypermethylation, snRNA transport and snRNP assembly, splicing, and decapping-initiated 5'-3' decay, whereas confusables emphasise polyadenylation, histone mRNA, rRNA and Pol I/III transcription.

name: Regulation of adrenal corticosteroid synthesis and aldosterone secretion
rationale: Members regulate cortisol, glucocorticoid, mineralocorticoid and aldosterone synthesis and secretion, unlike confusables listing CYP enzyme reactions/defects, cortisol response or renal aldosterone effects.

name: Renin-angiotensin elevation of systemic arterial pressure
rationale: All members concern angiotensin signaling and renin-angiotensin control of blood volume and vascular resistance raising arterial pressure, unlike confusables on vasoconstriction, endothelin, NO/cGMP or renal sodium handling.

name: Nucleotide pool sanitation and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members combine NUDT-mediated (deoxy)nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and DNA protection with abacavir, ribavirin, azathioprine/TPMT metabolism, the drug arm that confusables on purine/pyrimidine synthesis and catabolism lack.

name: Inhibitory synapse assembly and presynaptic release potentiation
rationale: Members cover GABA-receptor and gephyrin clustering, inhibitory synapse assembly and IPSPs plus enhanced vesicle exocytosis and LGI-ADAM synaptic organisation, versus excitatory/NMDA-PSD95 or presynaptic channel confusables.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ growth control and AP-2 transcription factors
rationale: Members center on Hippo signaling, YAP/TAZ transcription and cell-density sensing, with TFAP2 activity regulation and growth-factor braking distinguishing it from PTK6, senescence, TGF-beta mutant and anoikis confusables.

name: Nucleotide-sugar supply for GPI anchors and glycosphingolipids
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis and SLC35 transport (and their defects), GPI anchor synthesis/attachment and glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis, distinct from N-glycan, sialic acid and dolichol confusables.

name: Mitochondrial respiration control and peroxide- or iron-driven cell death
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation/respiration and ROS production together with H2O2-, hypoxia- and iron-driven apoptotic and ferroptotic death, which confusables split into either respiration or ROS detoxification.

qualifier: galactose, fructose and polyol inborn errors
name: Galactose, fructose and polyol catabolism with inborn errors
rationale: Members cover the Leloir galactose pathway, fructose catabolism, alditol metabolism and their enzyme deficiencies, distinct from pentose/xylulose and glycerol confusables.

qualifier: VLDL and chylomicron lipolysis and clearance
name: VLDL and chylomicron remodeling, lipolysis and clearance
rationale: Members concern assembly, LPL/LIPC-mediated remodeling and clearance of VLDL and chylomicrons, unlike confusables on intestinal assembly, LDL receptor endocytosis or HDL/LDL remodeling.

name: Intracellular bacterial invasion and phagosome-autophagy subversion
rationale: Members describe Listeria/Mtb host-cell entry, phagosome acidification and fusion, xenophagy and their pathogen-driven blockade, distinct from toxin, antimicrobial-granule and coronavirus confusables.

name: White adipocyte differentiation and adipose tissue development
rationale: All members concern white adipocyte differentiation and adipose development (PPARG target control), unlike PPARA, NR1H, PGC-1alpha and clock-driven metabolic confusables.

name: Antifungal lectin receptor-Th17 axis with IL-18/IL-36 signaling
rationale: Members join Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN fungal sensing, IL-17/Th17 and IL-23 production with IL-1-family IL-18, IL-36 and IL-38 signaling; the IL-18 and lectin members separate it from IL-10/IL-12 and IL-1 processing confusables.

name: Nuclear envelope remodeling and integrin-ILK cytoskeletal anchoring
rationale: Members cover nuclear envelope/lamina disassembly and reassembly and nuclear positioning, plus PINCH-ILK-parvin focal adhesion and actin capping that confusables on ESCRT sealing, cytokinesis and NPC lack.

name: Motile cilium dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance
rationale: All members concern motile cilium build-up (inner/outer dynein arms, protein targeting) and its airway clearance function, unlike sperm flagellum and multiciliogenesis/ependymal confusables.

name: Oncogenic RTK fusions and amplifications activating PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK/LTK and CSF1R fusion/amplification signaling feeding PI3K-AKT and ERK, distinct from ligand-driven FGFR/ERBB cascades and TKI-resistance mutant confusables.

name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint, midzone assembly and cytokinesis
rationale: Members cover spindle assembly and elongation, kinetochore attachment, MAD2 checkpoint, midzone and cytokinesis regulation, distinct from cohesion/centromere, APC/C and contractile-ring confusables.

qualifier: NADPH oxidase ROS and peroxide control
name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and peroxide control
rationale: Members regulate NADPH oxidase superoxide and H2O2 generation and degradation in phagocytes, unlike confusables on degranulation, Fc/complement receptors and chemotaxis.

name: Insulin/IGF1R-PI3K-AKT signaling and glycogen synthesis control
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC activation, PI3K-AKT signaling and its attenuation with glycogen and glucose-uptake control, distinguishing it from GLUT4/adiponectin and oncogenic RTK confusables.

name: Inositol pyrophosphate, nuclear phosphoinositide and PTEN regulation
rationale: Most members concern inositol (pyro)phosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide synthesis, NUDT pyrophosphate hydrolysis and PTEN localization/stability, which AKT- and ceRNA-focused PTEN confusables lack.
